Subject: Security intake: regional hosting & VPC topology for Veridian pilot

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Veridian is interested in running a short pilot for provider-facing features, and our InfoSec team needs a concise packet to review. We have two primary asks up front:

1) Residency & hosting: Can you confirm which parts of our data can be hosted in EU-only nodes vs US-only? We need a short statement that explains:
   - Where tensors/checkpoints (if any) and logs are stored
   - Whether any metadata or derived embeddings are ever replicated outside the specified region

2) Private deployment controls: For the pilot we expect to use a VPC/private endpoint. Please provide an updated VPC topology diagram showing private peering, NAT/Egress points, and KMS partitioning, plus a short note on operator access (SOC2 controls + SIG/CAIQ references).

Target timeline: can we get a preliminary packet in 10 business days? If you have a CAIQ or completed SIG questionnaire on file, that would speed the review.

Also, we will need a contact for an ops call — our security engineer (cc’d: security@veridianhealth.com) may request more detail after they review.

Best,
Laura Chen\Security Architect\Veridian Health

Jordan — pulled the artifacts and generated the annotated topology. Quick deliverables (attached):

- redwood_soc2-summary.pdf — one-page SOC 2 summary (scope: infra + platform; includes auditor and report year)
- redwood_caiq-completed.xlsx — completed CAIQ answers (marked where evidence is in drive)

2) Private deployment (VPC): supports EU-only tenancy and customer-managed KMS. Operator access is via a just-in-time, audited bastion described in the SIG answers (exceptions appendix covers temporary cross-region troubleshooting steps).

Ops contact for pilot: Irene Choi (irene.choi@redwood.com). Proposed delivery timeline: artifacts + topology by EOD 2026-10-04 (5 business days), follow-up ops call week of 2026-10-07.

If that timeline works I’ll package the artifacts and create a shared folder link for Veridian.
